title: Closed-Form Evaluation of Arctanh Power Sums via Infinite Products
summary: We establish closed-form expressions for the infinite series sum from n=2 to infinity of arctanh(n^-k) for all integers k >= 2 by connecting these sums to infinite product formulas involving the gamma function. Our approach uses logarithmic manipulations, the Fubini-Tonelli theorem, and Frullani's integral theorem. As applications, we derive a structural identity relating the Riemann zeta function zeta(k) to these sums, establish a new series representation for the Euler-Mascheroni constant gamma, and show that this representation admits an exponentially convergent reformulation via zeta…
